definitions.x: Stockfish eval in pawns at 50k nodes, side to move, clipped to +-10, mate +-12; x~ = scale*tanh(x/scale) if scale > 0
definitions.m: (material - 40) / 40, P=1 N=B=3 R=5 Q=9, both sides
definitions.probabilities: win = sigmoid(eta - h), loss = sigmoid(-eta - h), draw = 1 - win - loss

data.source: Lichess standard rated 2026-10 (start of month), blitz/rapid/classical, both players in one 200-point band, 800-2399, plies 12/24/36/48
